evidence: After BlueBird 8-13 launches, AST reported 13 in-orbit spacecraft.
Six spacecraft were launched within 50 days.
BlueBird 17-46 were in various stages of production/assembly.
Definitive agreements include AT&T, Verizon, Vodafone/SatCo and STC.
Partnerships with >60 MNOs covering >3B subscribers globally.
Q2 revenue $31.5M from gateway deliveries and U.S. government milestones.
10-Q explicitly states SpaceMobile Service has not launched and has generated no revenue to date.
FCC authorization received to deploy the planned 248-satellite network, including low-band IMT frequencies and Q/V feeder links.
Company received certain regulatory approvals for SpaceMobile Service in April 2026.
